associations.rationale: The basis conclusion records spanning and linear independence of the matrix coefficients, but it does not state the averaging-projector or sum-of-squares proof asserted by the source.
This declaration constructs the averaged linear map used in the proof, but its type alone states neither that it is a projector nor the orthogonality-and-spanning conclusion.
The theorem shows that an averaged linear map is invariant, a proof ingredient rather than the source claim about the projector, sum-of-squares formula, orthogonality, and spanning.
